info.title: Paygate Merchant API
info.description:
One endpoint handles every request: `POST /api/Process/Request` with the header `api-version: 2.0`.
`requestType` in the body picks the operation, and `data` carries its fields.

## Authentication

Each request proves it comes from you in one of two ways:

- **Request signature (preferred).** Send `X-Callback-Signature`: the lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact raw body, keyed with your mid secret in lower case. Sign the bytes you send; re-serialising the JSON changes them.
- **Hash field.** Without the header, put `hash` in `data`: the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the fields listed in its description, joined with `~`, ending with your mid secret in lower case.

## Responses

The HTTP status is always 200. `success: false` with an `error[]` entry means the request was rejected.
`success: true` means it was accepted; `data.status` and the callback to your `notificationUrl` give the outcome.
Check `data.hash` before trusting a response or callback.

Sending the same `merchantRefNo` again returns the original transaction instead of creating a second one.

Other `requestType` values exist for specific products; they are not part of this document.

Returned in `error[].errorCode`. Some messages are replaced with a more specific text at runtime.

post.summary: Create a payin, payout or refund, or query a status or balance.
post.description:
`requestType` picks the operation and the shape of `data`. Send header `api-version: 2.0`; without it the request goes to the legacy v1 API.
            
The response is always HTTP 200. Check `success` and `error[]`, then `data.status`.
            
**Order of checks.** The first failing check returns its error:
            
1. Body: request missing 11076, `requestType` missing 11071, `data` missing 11110.
2. `X-Callback-Signature`, when sent: bad signature 11031.
3. Unknown `requestType` 11051, then the basic fields of `data` (see each field's description). PAYIN and PAYOUT: 11078, 11028, 11001, 11012, 11135, 11006, 11007, 11004, 11005, 11011.
4. Merchant and configuration: 11002, 11023, 11024, 11025, payins disabled 11026, payouts disabled 11088, daily limit 11089, amount limits 11032 and 11033, blacklist 11087.
5. Customer fields (11013 to 11022, 11131, 11132), callback URLs (11008, 11009), duplicate reference (11027) and `hash` (11010, 11031).
6. `paymMethodFields`: required keys and formats are configured per payment method, country and currency, so ask us for the list for each method you enable.
7. Payouts only: available balance 11081, sender details 11442 to 11451.
            
An unexpected failure returns `00` "internal system error"; retry with GetStatus before resending.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: Must be `2.0`. Without it the request is routed to the legacy v1 API.

parameters.name: X-Callback-Signature
parameters.description: Optional request signature: lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact raw request body, keyed with your mid secret in lower case. A `sha256=` prefix is allowed. When it is valid, the `hash` field in `data` is not checked. A wrong signature returns 11031.

transaction_id.description: Our transaction ID; use it for GetStatus and REFUND.

hash.description: SHA-256 of `midCode~transaction_id~merchantRefNo~status~amount(0.00)~midsecret`; hosted payins add `~checkout_url` before the secret. Check it before trusting the response.

status.description: Transaction status, e.g. `PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `DECLINED`. The final status arrives in the callback.

checkout_url.description: Hosted payins: redirect the customer here.

checkout_html.description: Some seamless methods return an HTML form to render for the customer instead.

errorCode.description: See the error code table in the API description.

success.description: `false` when validation failed; `error` then says why. A `true` request can still end up with a `DECLINED` status.

ErrorResponseBody.description: Rejected request, for any requestType: `success` is false, `error[]` says why and `data` is null.

midcode.description: Your merchant ID code. Required (11001); must be a known merchant (11002).

hash.description: SHA-256 of `midcode~midsecret`. Not needed with a valid `X-Callback-Signature`. Missing 11010, mismatch 11031.

success.description: `false` when validation failed; `error` then says why. A `true` request can still end up with a `DECLINED` status.

GetBalanceResponseData.description: `data` returned for requestType GetBalance, in your processing currency.

GetStatusRequestBody.description: Get the current status of a payin, payout or refund.

midcode.description: Your merchant ID code. Required (11001); must be a known merchant (11002).

hash.description: SHA-256 of `midcode~transaction_id~transaction_type(lower case)~midsecret`; leave `transaction_id` empty when looking up by `merchant_ref_no`. Not needed with a valid `X-Callback-Signature`. Missing 11010, mismatch 11031.

GetStatusRequestDto.description: `data` for requestType GetStatus. Send `transaction_id` or `merchant_ref_no` (11455); `transaction_id` wins when both are sent.

RefundRequestBody.description: Refund a payin, fully or partly.

transaction_id.description: The payin to refund. Required (11072); must be your transaction (11073).

merchant_ref_no.description: Your unique reference for this refund. Required (11012), at most 100 chars with no whitespace (11135).

hash.description: SHA-256 of `midcode~transaction_id~merchant_ref_no~refund_amount(0.00)~midsecret`. Not needed with a valid `X-Callback-Signature`. Missing 11010, mismatch 11031.

success.description: `false` when validation failed; `error` then says why. A `true` request can still end up with a `DECLINED` status.

midCode.description: Your merchant ID code. Required (11001); must be a known merchant (11002).

integrationType.description: `S` for seamless (server to server) or `PG_H` for the hosted checkout page. Required (11078).

amount.description: Amount in `currency`, a number or numeric string. Must be greater than 0 (11011).

hash.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the fields configured for the payment method, joined with `~` and ending with your mid secret. Hosted: `midCode~merchantRefNo~amount(0.00)~currency~midsecret`. Not needed when a valid `X-Callback-Signature` header is sent. Missing 11010, mismatch 11031.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. `EGP`. Required (11004), 3 letters (11005), enabled for you (11023).

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. `EG`. Required (11006), 2 letters (11007), enabled for you (11024), valid with the currency (11025).

merchantRefNo.description: Your unique reference. Required (11012), at most 100 chars with no whitespace (11135), unique per merchant (11027). Resending a known reference returns the existing transaction.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method code, e.g. `BT`, `UPI`, `CARD`, `WT`. Required for seamless (11028); must be enabled for you (11355).

paymMethodFields.description: Payment-method-specific fields such as `account_number` or `bank_code`. Keys are case-sensitive; which keys are required, and their formats, are configured per payment method.

subscriptionId.description: Subscription ID, for subscription payins only.

token.description: Saved card token, for tokenized card payins only.

businessCategory.description: Set to `Import&Export` for trade payins; `businessTransaction` is then required (11322 to 11345).

notificationUrl.description: Your HTTPS endpoint for the transaction callback. Required (11008).

returnUrl.description: Where the customer is sent after paying. Required for payins (11009).

phone.description: Digits with an optional leading `+` (11192), 9 to 15 long (11020). Missing: 11019.

ipAddress.description: Customer's IPv4 or IPv6 address. Required only where the country or payment method needs it (11131); invalid 11132.

RequestUserInfoDto.description: Customer details. Payins require every field except `ipAddress` by default; payouts require `firstName`, `lastName`, `phone` and `email`. Some countries and payment methods change this.

midCode.description: Your merchant ID code. Required (11001); must be a known merchant (11002).

integrationType.description: Payouts are always seamless; leave blank or send `S`.

amount.description: Amount in `currency`, a number or numeric string. Must be greater than 0 (11011) and within your payout limits (11032, 11033).

hash.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the fields configured for the payment method, joined with `~` and ending with your mid secret. Not needed when a valid `X-Callback-Signature` header is sent. Missing 11010, mismatch 11031.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. `EGP`. Required (11004), 3 letters (11005), enabled for you (11023).

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. `EG`. Required (11006), 2 letters (11007), enabled for you (11024), valid with the currency (11025).

info.description: Free-text note stored with the payout.

merchantRefNo.description: Your unique reference. Required (11012), at most 100 chars with no whitespace (11135), unique per merchant (11027). Resending a known reference returns the existing payout.

paymentMethod.description: Payout method code, e.g. `BT`, `NB`, `MWALLET`, `PIX`. Required (11028); must be enabled for you (11355).

paymMethodFields.description: Beneficiary account fields such as `account_number`, `account_name`, `bank_code`, `bank_ifsc`. Required. Keys are case-sensitive; which keys are required, and their formats, are configured per payment method.

user_category.description: Your customer category, e.g. `new` or `existing`. Required for payins by default (11114).

device_fingerprint.description: Device fingerprint from the risk SDK, if you use it.

SenderDetail.description: The remitter of a cross-border payout. `senderType` is `Individual` or `Corporate`.

transaction_id.description: Our payout ID; use it for GetStatus.

hash.description: SHA-256 of `midCode~transaction_id~merchantRefNo~status~amount(0.00)~midsecret`. Check it before trusting the response.
